spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact specified surface — document.spellCheckCustomDictionary, addWords/removeWords, the deliberate absence of read-back — and explains why presence-of-the-attribute is the recommended feature test.

interactive.rationale: The probe table is a real live check filled at load, but the page offers no user-triggerable control at all (zero buttons/inputs) — on a browser without the API there is nothing to press, which drops below the every-concept-is-interactive bar even for a probe page.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The obvious-vs-correct feature test framing matches the table.

edge_cases.rationale: The read-back row treats absence as the correct answer, and the interface-without-attribute trap is covered.

conformance.rationale: The suite is correct against the spec; 5/7 assertions fail here because the API is absent from this build — the honest unsupported record, not a defect.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Probe ran live: attribute absent, correctly reported as the specified behaviour for a browser without the feature; console clean.

telemetry_health.rationale: Load-time probe records state but nothing is falsifiable.

accessibility.rationale: Table scoped, text explains every row, visible focus on links.

openQuestions.title: Add a user-triggerable probe action to probe-and-shape
openQuestions.detail: The page auto-fills its probe table at load and offers no control to press — the only zero-control concept found in v153. Add a re-probe button and/or a try-the-call button that attempts document.spellCheckCustomDictionary.addWords(['term']) and displays the real outcome (TypeError on absence; success on a supporting build), keeping the page honest while giving it an interaction.

openQuestions.title: Verify the API on a build that has it and record the flag story
openQuestions.detail: All API rows read absent on Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 and 5/7 conformance assertions fail. The chromestatus entry lists the feature for 153; establish whether it shipped later in the cycle, is behind a flag (none documented on the page), or is desktop-channel-gated, and update the index banner with the exact enable steps.

summary: Verified on headless Chromium 153 (Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12) driven over CDP via a Playwright script — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud environment; desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3 screenshots captured and inspected. Honest probe of an absent API, but the page needs at least one real control to meet the interactivity bar.
